notes: BetPool (src/BetPool.sol) is a pari-mutuel betting pool for NIGHTSHIFT games and Agent Arena. Its constructor takes no arguments and makes no external calls; it sets EIP-712 domain NightshiftBets/1 and initial per-bet limits (IMD 0.1-500, SHIFT 1000-25000000 whole tokens). Fixed constants: owner 0x6c4c78f2c3bdf4c4318fe305fb1c8bc1694d19b5 (named in the brief), tokens IMD 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 and SHIFT 0xe5e58e53d0bb204aa62c995a6c8cc8a48e60c3ac, fee splitter 0x1119d5df2f046bc2d3c0f6279ef2e9ce49422d44, 5% fee on the losing side only, hard caps 10000 IMD and 500000000 SHIFT. The owner can only setSigner, setLimits within the caps, and pause/unpause new markets and bets; settle, expire and claim always work. The NIGHTSHIFT result signer address was not given in the brief, so it starts unset and signed actions revert until the owner calls setSigner with the operator's backend signer (the one used by GameEscrow 0xf460fd9ad76f18414f54a2431870e8a116193489). No proxy, delegatecall, selfdestruct or token sweep.
